//: The Astro build uses format:'file', so pages are emitted as docs.html, pricing.html and dashboard.html rather than docs/index.html. Vercel serves a plain output directory literally, so without cleanUrls every extensionless route except / returned 404 - only / resolved, by the index.html directory convention. cleanUrls makes /docs serve docs.html and redirects /docs.html to /docs, which matches the site's own internal links and its trailingSlash:'never' setting.
